== Strategy ==

The intent of the Tie Scout Swarm/Retrieval Deck is to retrieve force and to overpower space decks and counter assault ground decks. There's a great deal of strategy used in the execution of this deck.

Use a starting Interrupt to pull your most effective Effect (usually Sienar Fleet Systems or Oppressive Enforcement). Build a space presence, and counter assault locations where your opponent has an average of 3 or less of power per character, vehicle or starship. Then cancel a Force drain with Dreaded Imperial Starfleet, use Darth Vader, Dark Lord of the Sith to choke with ease, combine the Womp Rats to eat all those pesky characters and then retrieve lots of Force deploying TIE Scouts with Sienar Fleet Systems. Do this with the Big Ones and Return to Base.

Your opponent will have to draw asteroid destiny on two TIE Scouts at the Big One. With a maneuver of 1 it will be lost easily. One goes to the used pile using the Sienar Fleet Systems game text while the other goes on Return To Base. Deploy two more next turn and repeat. The rest of the Effects and Interrupts are counter strategies for other decks.
